about_the_game:
This is a horror adventure game that portrays the deep bond between a cat and its owner.

You awaken in an unfamiliar world. As a cat, you must search for your owner from whom you've been separated. Your only guide is the fragments of happy memories your owner left behind.

Survive a world roamed by terrifying monsters. Hide in the shadows, use your wits, and pave your way forward with the unique agility that only a cat possesses.
*Please note: While the game involves monsters attacking the cat, there are no realistic depictions of the cat being harmed.

Before you begin, you can name the "Owner" and the "Cat." This makes the story uniquely yours. With a playtime of about two hours, this compact experience is filled with fright, sorrow, and heartwarming emotion.

Key Features

  • Genre: Meowmare Adventure
    A world where cherished memories ("Meowmories") have twisted into a "Meowmare." Beyond the horror, a heartwarming conclusion awaits.

  • Explore from a Cat's Perspective
    Experience fear through the eyes of a small cat and utilize its agility for unique exploration that will draw you deeper into the story.

  • A Condensed, Emotional Story
    With an estimated playtime of 1-2 hours, this game offers a condensed narrative about a bond that transcends words. After a thrilling and suspenseful experience, you'll be left with a lasting warmth in your heart upon completion.

  • Price: We plan to release the game at an affordable price of under $5.

  • Multiple Endings
    The ending changes based on the mementos you find scattered throughout this world.

content_descriptors.notes: Blood is depicted in some in-game graphics, including certain background images. There are also violent depictions, but no direct portrayal of cats being injured.

short_description: Our memories will bring us back together. A bittersweet and heartwarming "Meowmare" adventure about a cat's journey to find its owner. This is your story, and the story of your beloved cat.
